Leah: quick handoff — I'm on for the late PM shift. Short list of things to watch (non-incident):
- encoder-cache processes have been noisy on eu-west nodes (sporadic 5xx spikes).
- prefetch KV alerts pop during autoscale windows (~03:00-04:00 UTC).
- occasional tail-latency blips on small shards after A/B rollout.

Actions I took: pinned kv-prefetch rollout back to v1.2.3 for eu-west, reduced batch_size -> 8, and enabled extra logging on encoder pool. If you see ALERT-ENC-42 or PREFETCH-TP-7 firing, it's likely the noise pattern we saw earlier.

Marta: noted. Any quick mitigations if the encoder pool keeps flapping?

Leah: yeah — short checklist: 1) check `stackdriver.metrics("encoder_pool")` for spike shape, 2) if it's a single node, run `scripts/evict_prefetch.sh node=$NODE` to drain and restart the container, 3) don't escalate unless error rate > 3% sustained for 5m or latency > 500ms p95.

Ashok: where's the runbook link?

Leah: runbook is here: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/encoder-prefetch — main mitigation section is under "Temporary drains and backoff". Note: there are some false positives from the EU autoscaler when nodes spin up; rely on p95 and error-rate checks, not just alert count.

Ryan: I'll mute the duplicate notifications in #alerts-duplicates for the night, will only let through the new alert thresholds. If anything crosses the thresholds, page me + Ashok.

oncall-bot: reminder — rotation swap scheduled at 23:30 UTC.

Marta: small FYI — we saw a telemetry duplication issue in dev last week (horizon-drift) that manifests as double traces; affects alert dedupe. If you see two nearly identical traces, mark them as dup and don't escalate immediately. Ticket: INT-9876.

Ashok: thanks, added INT-9876 to my watchlist. If it becomes noisy we can temporarily tighten the dedupe window in prod config: `telemetry.dedupe_window_ms = 3000`.

Leah: final: if you hit sustained failures while draining, escalate to infra oncall (page string: `infra-pager`). Otherwise comment here and I'll follow up in the morning. Tagging @Marta for follow-up on runbook updates. :thumbsup:
